title: Sargas' Vitality Network (Starfinder 2e)
description: Automates the Starfinder 2e Mystic's Vitality Network: turn-start recharge, the Transfer Vitality per-use limit, and point spending through a popup or chat card, with the healing rolled ready to apply (pf2e-toolbelt adds a per-target apply button). Built for the Starfinder 2e system, with secondary support for Pathfinder 2e + Starfinder Anachronism.

recommends.reason: Its Target Helper adds an apply-healing button for the Transfer Vitality target.
Only needed on the Pathfinder 2e system, to provide the Mystic and its Vitality Network.

conflicts.reason: The original module this one is forked from. Running both recharges and spends the network twice.
Also automates the Vitality Network. Running both recharges and spends the network twice.
